text: 10月8日是假期后首个交易日，有20只基金将开启认购，形成10月首个发行小高峰。20只产品中包含被动指数型基金7只、偏股混合型基金5只、债券型基金3只、增强指数型基金3只，另有FOF基金和REITs各1只。从投资主题看，科技成长方向布局最为集中，涉及科创板芯片设计、科创创业人工智能、软件开发、机器人等多个细分领域。红利与价值风格同步升温，银华中证全指红利质量ETF、广发中证红利低波动ETF、农银国证价值100等指数产品相继上新。值得注意的是，刚刚过去的三季度，新基金发行呈现“数量增、份额减”的结构性特征。（中证报）
text_en: October 8 is the first trading day after the holiday, and 20 funds will open for subscription, forming the first small issuance peak in October. The 20 products include 7 passive index funds, 5 partial-equity hybrid funds, 3 bond funds, 3 enhanced index funds, and 1 each of FOF funds and REITs. In terms of investment themes, the technology growth direction is the most concentrated, involving multiple sub-sectors such as STAR Market chip design, STAR and ChiNext artificial intelligence, software development, and robotics. Dividend and value styles are also heating up simultaneously, with index products such as Yinhua CSI All Share Dividend Quality ETF, GF CSI Dividend Low Volatility ETF, and ABC Guozheng Value 100 launching one after another. It is worth noting that in the just-passed third quarter, new fund issuance showed a structural characteristic of "more in number, less in shares." (China Securities Journal)
